name: mutsumi-markdown-editor
description: A clean Vditor-based WYSIWYG Markdown editor for VuePress blogs.

mutsumiMarkdown.imageRoot.description: Directory inside the public assets directory used for pasted images.

mutsumiMarkdown.contentRoot.description: Workspace-relative content root removed from article paths when deriving image folders.

mutsumiMarkdown.imageName.description: Pasted image file name template. Supports ${timestamp}, ${now}, ${fileName}, ${ext}, and ${originalName}.

mutsumiMarkdown.imagePathTemplate.description: Optional workspace-relative or absolute pasted image path template. Supports ${workspaceDir}, ${publicDir}, ${imageRoot}, ${contentRoot}, ${relativeDir}, ${fileName}, ${relativePath}, ${imageName}, ${timestamp}, ${now}, ${ext}, and ${originalName}. When empty, the editor uses publicDir/imageRoot/contentRoot/imageName.

mutsumiMarkdown.markdownImagePathTemplat.description: Optional Markdown image link template. Supports the same variables as imagePathTemplate. When empty, links are derived from publicDir, such as /images/article/name.png.
